newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Normandy Q1 net profit A$20.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Normandy Q1 net profit A$20.5 mln.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Wednesday profit after tax was A$20.5 million for the three months to September 30, 1996.

Normandy said the first quarter net was below the target result for the quarter, reflecting the impact of production problems at Mount Leyshon in Queensland and Bounty in Western Australia and the continuing poor zinc price.
The group gave no comparative figures for the year earlier.
Normandy said managed gold output was 346,475 ounces in the September quarter. Mine operating costs were A$360 per ounce.

Exploration expenditure for the quarter on projects in which Normandy holds direct interests, including mine site exploration, was A$10.8 million, Normandy said in its September quarter production report.
Normandy chairman Robert Champion de Crespigny said gold production was mixed in the September quarter, with record output from KCGM in Western Australia.
This was offset by less satisfactory results at three other major Normandy mines, particularly Boddington where production fell 25 percent due to a much lower average head grade, de Crespigny said.
Production at Big Bell fell 28 percent short of the record June quarter and production from Mt Leyshon was also lower due to limited access to high grade ore zones.
